A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Poldt]] named '''Fanta''' was a spectator of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY.]] at some point during the event he bickered with [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].

==Biography==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Fanta was a spectator of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|annual]] [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] at [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the race, a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] continuously tried to peer over [[Gender/Legends|his]] shoulder to see the race on his hand held [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]. This annoyed Fanta, who apparently wanted nothing to do with Binks, and he intentionally hid his screen from the Gungan's view throughout the race. Shortly after [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros']] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] exploded before the second lap, Binks pounded on Fanta's back in excitement, which prompted the [[Poldt]] to grimace and try to move away.<ref name="Novelization" />

==Personality and traits==
Fanta was a male Poldt, a slender and uniquely sculpted [[Species/Legends|Species]].<ref name="Novelization" />He possessed a sour attitude, at least towards Jar Jar Binks During the Boonta Eve Classic.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Phanta_the_Nimoidian.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A colored sketch labelled both as "Nimoidian" and "Phanta"]]
{{Quote|What gooie-on?''"<br />"''Bug off.|Jar Jar Binks and Fanta in the screenplay|<ref name="TPMIS">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref>}}
Fanta the Poldt was to appear in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. While his scene was ultimately left on the cutting room's floor, it remained in both the screenplay<ref name="TPMIS" /> and in [[Terry Brooks]]' movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]], thus ensuring Fanta's [[canon]]icity.<ref name="Novelization" /> To create the Poldt's likeness, Lucasfilm Ltd. used discarded pieces of Neimoidian concept art.<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> Originally, the Neimoidians were meant to be computer-generated, and George Lucas envisioned them as the organic models of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s that made up the Trade Federation army. However, when the decision was made to portray the Neimoidians with actors wearing animatronic masks, the original design was deemed too impractical.<ref name="TPMmak">''[[Star Wars: The Making of Episode I The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> The creation crew later took the discarded Neimoidian design and used it to create Fanta the Poldt. A few of the sketches shown in the interactive CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'' are labelled both "Neimoidian" (or some variation of that word) and the name "Phanta." Later sketches were just labelled "Fanta," with no specific species.<ref name="TPMIG" /> The original Neimoidian concept art was later refined into the Geonosians during the pre-production [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="dbG">{{DB|species|geonosian|Geonosian}}</ref>
